-module(halt_catch_after).
-export([run/0]).
run()->try erlang:halt(41) catch _:_ -> io:put_chars("CATCH\n") after io:put_chars("AFTER\n") end,io:put_chars("CONTINUE\n").

-module(halt_probe_server).
-behaviour(gen_server).
-export([init/1,handle_call/3,handle_cast/2,handle_info/2,terminate/2,code_change/3]).
init(_)->erlang:halt(41).
handle_call(_,_,S)->{reply,ok,S}.
handle_cast(_,S)->{noreply,S}.
handle_info(_,S)->{noreply,S}.
terminate(_,_) -> io:put_chars("TERMINATE\n").
code_change(_,S,_)->{ok,S}.

Evidence.DumpFormat: CLR/OS minidump; not a BEAM crash dump
